'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Justin Montgomery DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Montgomery]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Recking Ball.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time (Virtual Block 1)|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time]]
* '''Username:''' cardlicker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
